descripcion: Greet, present, ask the name and origin; choose pronouns and courtesy formulas.
Give personal data and present others with pronouns, basic questions and places of origin.
Talk about appearance, clothes and colors; practice adjectives, order of words and descriptive questions.
Present the family, indicate ages, possession and where people and things are.
Describe the day, express the time and order actions with time markers.
Talk about tastes, skills and activities; distinguish denial and practice frequent verbs.
Name meals and flavors, ask with courtesy and speak of simple quantities.
Understand short calls and messages; express actions already made, pending, future or ongoing.
Ask for locations, indicate location and follow transport and guidance instructions.
Ask for prices, quantities and haggle; review the level in a cumulative examination.
Describe time and seasons; ask for causes, compare temperatures and use duplication to talk about various elements.
Talk about professions and symptoms, express how to achieve goals and recognize meN- verbs of tool and direction.
Describe buildings, invite to participate and understand warnings, rules and steps to use the nearby train.
Describe clothes, choose sizes and use short invitations with silakan.
Express feelings, understand radio broadcasts and ask for a song.
Plan a way out and talk about natural destinations, activities and landscapes.
Write invitations, express good wishes and talk about experiences.
Understand notices, extracurricular activities, schedules and Pramuka's descriptions.
Talk about book loans, describe traditional clothes and recognize dances and culture.
Follow instructions to make batik and prepare food, count past experiences and review the level in a final exam.
To congratulate on achievements, express wishes and write personal messages with frequent prepositions.
To express recommendations and opinions on the environment, to talk about disasters and to propose community actions.
Summarize films, describe characters and actions, value a story and recommend it.
Define food, interpret nutritional labels and explain opinions about a culinary tradition.
Relating a working day, practicing transient verbs and knowing daily life in a floating market.
Explain a problem of sending, draft a courteous complaint and ask for a specific answer.
Tell a story of struggle and explain the active and passive voice by remembering important contributions.
Explain causes and consequences of floods, order action in the face of an earthquake and prepare a Community response.
Relating a legend, expressing reciprocal actions with ber-... an and interpreting the message of a story.
Plan a holiday, express full dates and describe a day off with akan and nanti.
Expose opinions on professions, describe requirements and draft an arguative text.
Express agreements and disagreements with courtesy, recognize reduplications and organize a public letter.
Describe in detail fortresses and monuments, explain conservation and compare by means of simile and hiperes.
Summarize news, analyse solutions to floods with cause and consequence and argue about school policies.
Remember national figures, describe celebrations and discuss their benefits and costs.
Summarize tourist news, weigh the impact of festivals and expose how tourism moves the local economy.
To understand information about asthma, to recognize nominalizations with peng-... -an and to present arguments about exercise and heart health.
Reconstruct orientation, conflict and closure; analyse complex nominal groups and recognize personification and irony.
To value policies to reduce plastic, to use meng-... -kan in beneficial and causative constructions, and to present proposals for reuse.
To understand speeches, present a tribute and write a chronological biography with modism and fact-based assessment.
